reviewNotes: Reviewed 34 original selection-format grammar/connective questions across 17 source rows; two je/desto rows deferred because pre-existing B2 target conflicts with B1 source level, one sodass source identified as duplicate orthographic variant of so dass. Review checked competing semantically valid answers, verb-final subordinate clauses, capitalized sentence starts, word-order logic, bilingual explanation/hint and completed forms. No source examples copied, no human approval, measured CEFR proficiency, publication or external model API. Structural validation is performed in GitHub Actions. Follow-up editorial pass corrected the verb-second order in one jedoch sentence after the first commit. Reviewed second jedoch variant and retained it. Report digest repaired on 2026-10-28 after CI detected an implementation error in the report SHA calculator; catalog content was unchanged during this digest repair.
